name: 2.7MM COMBO LCP STRAIGHT PLATES
description: A 2.7mm combo locking compression plate (LCP) straight plate is a low-profile, small-fragment orthopedic implant with combi holes that allow both standard cortical screws and locking screws, providing versatile, stable fracture fixation for small bones.
